label: bug
file: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

The issue isn't in the CSV writer. `dedupeKey` in `src/ingest/dedupe.ts` builds its key from only `date`, `amount`, and `description`, so two transactions that differ only in currency (e.g. EUR vs USD) produce the same key and one is dropped during ingestion as a duplicate before it ever reaches `src/export/csv.ts`. Since currency was only added to transactions after 3.2.0, this collision wasn't possible before that release. The key needs to include `currency` (or another currency-aware field) to avoid merging legitimately distinct transactions.
